items.title: The pullback of an injective module along a continuous cocontinuous functor has no higher cohomology on objects of the source site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the pullback of an injective module along a continuous cocontinuous functor of sites has vanishing higher cohomology on the objects of the source site (statement lines 9277-9285). The proof (proof lines 9287-9307) reduces to Cech cohomology, identifies the Cech complex of a covering with that of its image under u using cocontinuity and the compatibility of u with fibre products, and invokes the vanishing of Cech cohomology for injective modules. H2: one reduction plus one identification of complexes, written out.
